# Sakura Player v1.2.0-beta.1

**Sakura Player 首个公开 Beta / First public Beta of Sakura Player**

## 简体中文

Sakura Player 是由 Sakura520222 维护的 [SPlayer-Next](https://github.com/SPlayer-Dev/SPlayer-Next) 非官方 Fork，与上游项目无隶属关系，也不代表上游官方发行。本次是 Sakura Player 的首次独立发行，版本号沿用现有开发基线；并非从上游历史版本到此版本的完整更新汇总。

### 首次独立发行的改进

- 使用独立的应用标识、安装名称、仓库、文档和更新地址，可与上游并行安装，用户数据独立存放。
- Windows 便携版使用可执行文件旁的 `SakuraPlayerData/`，不自动迁移或修改上游的 `UserData/`。
- 新配置的 HTTP/WebSocket 与 MCP 默认端口分别为 `14568`、`14569`，服务默认关闭；保留已有配置中的端口。`splayer` 插件 API、原生模块别名，以及 `splayer://now-playing` 和 `splayer://library/summary` MCP 资源别名继续兼容。
- 新安装的 Beta 默认订阅 Beta 更新，稳定版默认 Stable；保存的用户选择继续有效。下载页在尚无 Stable、已有公开 Beta 时默认展示 Beta，并可手动切换通道。
- Windows 安装器添加“打开方式”选项；`orpheus://` 的启用由应用设置控制，启动时保留已有处理器。
- 保留 Windows、macOS、Linux 的 x64 与 ARM64 六个构建目标。Release 在全部构建及资源、更新清单校验完成后创建草稿，由维护者审查后手动公开。

### 保留的上游能力

FFmpeg/Rust 音频解码、丰富的歌词格式与逐字高亮、桌面歌词与灵动岛、Windows 任务栏歌词、媒体库、音乐服务器接入、系统媒体控件等能力继承自上游。它们不是本次 Fork 新增的功能；感谢 imsyy 和 SPlayer-Next 贡献者的工作。

### 下载与更新

| 平台    | 架构        | 包格式                                            |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows | x64 / ARM64 | 安装版 `.exe`、便携版 `.exe`                      |
| macOS   | x64 / ARM64 | `.dmg`、`.zip`                                    |
| Linux   | x64 / ARM64 | `.AppImage`、`.deb`、`.rpm`、`.tar.gz`、`.pacman` |

按设备架构选择发行页中的文件。Beta 不向 Stable 通道提供更新；稳定版发布后可被 Beta/Alpha 订阅者接收。Nightly 使用独立的滚动发行和更新清单。草稿不提供公开下载或自动更新。

### 已知限制

- 这是测试版本，仍可能存在问题。Windows 本地构建与基础冒烟已完成；macOS/Linux 和 ARM64 尚需真实设备上的安装、播放与更新验证，CI 构建成功不能替代这些验证。升级或迁移前请备份配置与音乐库。
- Windows 包目前未做代码签名；macOS 包未做签名和公证，系统可能显示信任提示。请仅使用本仓库发行页的资源。
- macOS、Windows 便携版及 Linux 解压版提供更新检查和外部下载；应用内下载安装仅对支持的安装形式开放。任务栏歌词和 WASAPI 独占输出仅适用于 Windows。
- 不自动导入上游便携数据。启用或卸载 `orpheus://` 集成不会保证恢复此前的用户选择；macOS 与上游共存时的链接处理仍需验证。
- Discord RPC 默认关闭，暂时保留上游 Application ID、资源和身份。独立 Sakura Player Discord 身份仍需维护者注册真实应用并提供资源。
- 在线音乐、歌词及其他第三方服务的可用性取决于各自的接口、账号与服务规则。已有兼容接口保留，不保证第三方服务持续可用。

### 来源与许可证

本项目继续按 **GNU AGPL-3.0** 发布。保留原始作者 imsyy、SPlayer-Next 贡献者和第三方组件的版权、许可证及署名。本版本的[对应源代码](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/tree/v1.2.0-beta.1)、[LICENSE](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/blob/v1.2.0-beta.1/LICENSE) 和 [NOTICE](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/blob/v1.2.0-beta.1/NOTICE) 与发行物一并提供；软件按许可证条款不提供担保。

遇到问题请在 [Sakura Player Issues](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/issues) 报告，并附上版本、系统、架构、安装形式和复现步骤。

## English

Sakura Player is an **unofficial fork** of [SPlayer-Next](https://github.com/SPlayer-Dev/SPlayer-Next), maintained by Sakura520222. It is independent of the upstream project and is not an official upstream release. This is Sakura Player's first independent distribution. Its version follows the existing development baseline; these notes do not present upstream historical commits as new fork features.

### Changes for the first independent release

- Independent application identity, installation names, repository, documentation and update links, with separate user data and side-by-side installation.
- Windows portable data lives in `SakuraPlayerData/` beside the executable. Upstream `UserData/` is neither automatically imported nor modified.
- Fresh HTTP/WebSocket and MCP configurations use ports `14568` and `14569`, with both services disabled by default. Saved ports, the `splayer` plugin API, native module aliases, and the `splayer://now-playing` and `splayer://library/summary` MCP resource aliases remain compatible.
- Fresh Beta installations follow Beta updates; stable installations default to Stable. Saved channel choices are preserved. The download page initially selects Beta when public Beta releases exist and Stable does not, while allowing manual channel selection.
- Windows installation adds Open With handlers. Settings control `orpheus://` integration; startup preserves existing handlers.
- All six Windows/macOS/Linux x64/ARM64 build targets and package formats remain available. Releases are prepared as drafts after all builds and asset/manifest checks, then published manually by the maintainer.

### Retained upstream capabilities

FFmpeg/Rust audio decoding, rich lyric formats and word highlighting, desktop and dynamic-island lyrics, Windows taskbar lyrics, the music library, media-server support and system media controls are inherited capabilities. Credit belongs to imsyy and the SPlayer-Next contributors; these are not new features introduced by this fork release.

### Packages and updates

Windows provides installer and portable `.exe` packages; macOS provides `.dmg` and `.zip`; Linux provides `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.tar.gz` and `.pacman`. Every platform targets both x64 and ARM64. Choose the architecture matching your device.

Beta releases do not update Stable subscribers. Future stable releases can reach Beta/Alpha subscribers. Nightly has a separate rolling release and update feed. Drafts are not publicly downloadable or discoverable by automatic updates.

### Known limitations

- This is a test release. Local Windows builds and basic smoke testing are complete; macOS/Linux and ARM64 still require installation, playback and update checks on real devices. Passing CI builds does not replace those checks. Back up settings and the library before upgrading or migrating.
- Windows packages are unsigned, and macOS packages are unsigned and not notarized. The OS may display trust prompts. Download only from this repository's release page.
- macOS, Windows portable and Linux archive builds offer update checks and external downloads. In-app download/install is available only for supported installation types. Taskbar lyrics and WASAPI exclusive output are Windows-only.
- Upstream portable data is not imported automatically. Disabling or uninstalling Orpheus integration does not guarantee restoration of a previous user choice; macOS link handling with both applications installed still needs validation.
- Discord RPC is disabled by default and temporarily retains the upstream Application ID, assets and identity. An independent Sakura Player Discord identity requires a real maintainer-owned application and assets.
- Online music, lyrics and other third-party integrations depend on their services, accounts and rules. Compatible interfaces are retained, but continued third-party availability is not guaranteed.

The [corresponding source](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/tree/v1.2.0-beta.1), [LICENSE](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/blob/v1.2.0-beta.1/LICENSE) and [NOTICE](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/blob/v1.2.0-beta.1/NOTICE) accompany this release. Report issues to [Sakura Player Issues](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/issues), including the version, OS, architecture, installation type and reproduction steps.
